_comment: Hành trình sự nghiệp content. Seeded by app/careers.py at startup: paths and skills are upserted by code, a changed path gets a new content_version, and a skill removed from here is retired (never deleted, its users' progress is kept). Codes are stored: never rename them. prerequisites are codes of the same path and must not form a cycle. assessment: [{q, options, answer (index)}].
